title: Zesty Gooey Russian Beef Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful Russian-inspired stew made with cranberry juice and grilled beef, served in a donabe vessel.
instructions: Preheat the yakimono-grill to medium-high heat and grill the beef short ribs until browned on all sides.
In a large donabe vessel, combine the grilled beef short ribs, cranberry juice, beef broth, yakimono-grill sauce, onion, garlic, carrots, and potatoes.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 2 hours, or until the meat is tender and the vegetables are cooked through.
Stir in the chopped fresh dill and season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with additional fresh dill if desired.
Let the stew rest for 10 minutes before serving to allow the flavors to meld together.
Serve the stew in bowls and enjoy as a solo dinner.
Refrigerate or freeze any leftovers for later use.
